facts.fact: ELECAM says it is deduplicating the biometric voter registry, which holds around 8.2 million registered voters, and has issued biometric voter cards (Biometric Update).
ELECAM announced in May 2025 that it took delivery of new biometric gear to support voter registration for the presidential election (Biometric Update).

systems.platform: biometric registration kits from Giesecke and Devrient, GenKey and Veridos
